# Phase 09 — Multi-Device System

## Vision
Secure multi-device AssistantX access with encrypted transport and controlled remote actions.

## Scope boundaries
- Device identity and pairing lifecycle
- Encrypted peer connectivity and policy checks
- Remote session orchestration and notifications
- No deep UI rewrite in this phase

## Dependencies on Phase 1
- IPC permissions and audit layer
- Router/orchestrator contracts
- Tool execution safety boundaries

## Security constraints
- End-to-end encrypted channels
- Device trust and revocation controls
- Least-privilege remote command scopes

## Rollout gates
- Internal alpha with trusted devices
- Session replay and abuse simulations
- Gradual rollout with telemetry checkpoints

## Success criteria
- Stable remote command execution
- Revocation effective within one session window
- No permission bypass in remote mode

## Risks
- Session hijacking complexity
- Network instability and reconnect storms
- Latency regressions on low-bandwidth links
